FRIGATE'S WATERFRONT BAR & GRILL

Does FRIGATE'S WATERFRONT BAR & GRILL keep a clean kitchen? Not quite — only a C, 76/100, the last time the state checked (March 10, 2026). That visit logged 2 high-priority, 2 intermediate, and 2 basic violations.

Inspectors cited 2 high-priority, 2 intermediate, and 2 basic violations. That puts it safer than 12% of Brevard County restaurants we grade. Diner rating: 4.3 from 3,751 reviews. Menus here flag vegetarian, dairy-free, keto, organic, and other dietary options.
